Bigfoot leaves a paper-trail, the gas prices in GTA VI, splitting the Bloomin Onion bill on a date, the board games people cheat at the most, and evidence of cheating on our very show: Join hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo on Bloomberg This Weekend for Bookmarked, where they share stories that caught their attention over the past week.
